title: Luma data-retention and training terms on file
summary: Collect and summarize Luma's terms for uploaded video/images and generated outputs before any user scan goes to Luma (M1 gate SECURITY_CHECKLIST §6.3).

acceptance_tests.test: legal/vendors/luma.md records: retention period for inputs and outputs, deletion API or request path, whether customer data trains models by default and how to opt out, DPA availability, processing region, with quotes, links, and retrieval date.
A red-flags list and a recommendation (use / use with opt-out / do not use) are stated; open questions are drafted as an email for the Owner to send.

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording

Public-terms research landed (legal/vendors/luma.md + research/vendors/luma.md). Red flags: trains on inputs by default (Enterprise-only no-train) and programmatic reconstruction appears deprecated. Recommendation: NOT usable on default terms; re-open the reconstruction vendor. Vendor-confirmed DPA still required (§6.3) — status stays open.

Luma dropped as the reconstruction backend (ADR-0005 / AUTH #018): self-host is the target, with a managed bridge (Autodesk APS or KIRI-under-terms) for early M1. This ticket now covers the bridge's data terms IF a bridge is used; the vendor comes from the M1-CAPT-03 spike. luma.md retained as superseded analysis.
